shared_context: Riverton's parks committee has a scheduled session on Thursday, 2026-09-17. The agenda includes a vote on relocating the skate park. The relocation has been through two noisy public-comment periods; the local paper ran letters both for and against last week. The committee has five members.

starting_events.description: The committee members are aware of the upcoming Thursday session and the skate-park relocation vote.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least one committee member voted against the skate-park relocation during the Thursday session before the cutoff. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
